        THE FIRST SCHEDULE.–CLASSIFICATION OF OFFENCES.

                                                      1
                          THE MINI CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973
                                    ACT NO. 2 OF 1974
                                                                                          [25th January, 1974.]
An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.
                                                      CHAPTER I
                                                     PRELIMINARY
    1. Short title and extent.—(1) This Act may be called the Mini Code.
    (2) It extends to the whole of India 1****:
    Provided that nothing in this Code applies to the tribal areas.
    2. Definitions.—In this Code, unless the context otherwise requires,—
         (a) ―bailable offence‖ means an offence which is shown as bailable; and
    which is made bailable by any other law;
         (b) ―charge‖ includes any head of charge.
    3. Bail where the offence is not serious.—A person accused of a minor offence shall be
released on bail.

1. The words ―except the State of Jammu and Kashmir‖ omitted by Act 34 of 2019, s. 95.
                                                      2
                                                CHAPTER V
                                              ARREST OF PERSONS
    41. When police may arrest without warrant.—(1) Any police officer may without an order
from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest any person who commits a cognizable offence in
his presence.
    (2) The officer shall record his reasons in writing.
     2
    [41A. Notice of appearance before police officer.—(1) The police officer shall issue a notice
directing the person to appear before him.]
    (2) Where such person complies with the notice, he shall not be arrested.
    Provided that the officer may arrest him for reasons to be recorded.
    Illustration.
    A is summoned by notice under sub-section (1). A appears. A is not arrested.
    42. [Repealed.]

2. Ins. by Act 25 of 2005, s. 2 (w.e.f. 23-6-2006).
                                                      3
    43. Saving.—Nothing in this Code affects any other law.
